content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: At least Class 12th pass Age limit: No age limit prescribed, provided the applicant is healthy and has no physical defect that makes them unable to do the work Other conditions: Applicant must be healthy, with no physical defect that makes them unable to do the work Applicant declares there is no conviction by any court and no criminal case pending against them Desirable: Preference: teachers, including retired teachers Preference: Anganwadi workers and doctors Preference: members of NGOs and clubs Preference: members of women's groups, Maitri Sanghs and self-help groups

content_sections.text: Candidates with pending criminal cases Law students enrolled as advocates

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: No salary or wage; a prescribed honorarium is payable from time to time as per directions of the State Legal Services Authority. Para Legal Volunteer work is purely service work, not a job

content_sections.heading: How Will District Legal Services Authority, Jhabua Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Scrutiny of applications and list of eligible and ineligible applicants Interview by the selection committee All applications scrutinised within one week of the last date; list of eligible and ineligible applicants prepared List displayed on the DLSA Jhabua notice board and uploaded on the District Court Jhabua website Eligible candidates selected through interview by the committee Separate intimation will be issued for the interview Selection committee has full right to accept or reject any application; its decision is final

content_sections.text: Certificate of educational qualification Aadhaar / Voter identity card Certificate of social work experience Certificate of special achievement or work Other certificates

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Legal Services Authority, Jhabua Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for District Legal Services Authority, Jhabua Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed format on page 2 of this PDF; also downloadable from https://jhabua.dcourts.gov.in) and send it to Office of the District Legal Services Authority, District Court Premises, Jhabua (M.P.), by deposit at the office of the district legal services authority, district court premises, jhabua, to reach by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for District Legal Services Authority, Jhabua Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No salary or wage; honorarium as fixed by the State Legal Services Authority from time to time.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: At least Class 12th pass.

faq.question: Q5. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be healthy, with no physical defect that makes them unable to do the work. Applicant declares there is no conviction by any court and no criminal case pending against them.

faq.question: Q6. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates with pending criminal cases. Law students enrolled as advocates.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications and list of eligible and ineligible applicants. Interview by the selection committee. All applications scrutinised within one week of the last date; list of eligible and ineligible applicants prepared. List displayed on the DLSA Jhabua notice board and uploaded on the District Court Jhabua website.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Para Legal Volunteer work is purely service work, not a job.

faq.question: Q9. Which places are covered by District Legal Services Authority, Jhabua Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: District Jhabua, Tehsil Thandla, Tehsil Petlawad, Legal aid clinics in gram panchayats, janpad panchayats, schools, colleges and other places.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Certificate of educational qualification; Aadhaar / Voter identity card; Certificate of social work experience; Certificate of special achievement or work; Other certificates.
